in_marathi.name: Bhumit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhumit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhumit is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words Bhumi, meaning 'earth' and 'foundation'. In Hindu mythology, Bhumidevi is the goddess of the earth, who provides stability and strength. The name Bhumit is thus a tribute to the divine power of the earth and the foundation it provides for life.
